title: Reporter Nur Aisyah was charged with spreading false news.
paragraphs: Warta Reporter Malumku, Nur Aisyah, was charged with spreading false news regarding the distribution of a catastrophic flood disaster.

According to the charges, Nur Aisyah published a report about the relief of the flood disaster on February 3, 2026, which the prosecutor judged to spread false information that caused havoc. The chapter used: section 28 verses (3) ITE Act (false information that caused havoc).
The indictment was read at Ambon State Court on April 14, 2026, the first hearing of the witness hearing was scheduled on May 5, 2026.
In the matter of Nur Aisyah, the power of Fitri Handayani's law called the news convicted without asking the expert opinion of the Press Council.
Nur Aisyah works as a reporter for Warta Malumku in Ambon.
The threat of punishment for this chapter is up to 6 years in prison.
